description: Declarative rules for the canonical ATLAS Audit Issue result. Executable evaluators and actions are registered in js/23-atlas-audit-issues.js.

rules.title: Audit name is missing
rules.summary: The audit does not have a name.
rules.detail: The audit does not have a name.

rules.title: Audit description is missing
rules.summary: The audit does not have a description or purpose.
rules.detail: The audit does not have a description or purpose.

rules.title: Assigned analyst is missing
rules.summary: The audit does not have a assigned analyst.
rules.detail: The audit does not have a assigned analyst.

rules.title: Backup analyst is missing
rules.summary: The audit does not have a backup analyst.
rules.detail: The audit does not have a backup analyst.

rules.title: Developer is missing
rules.summary: The audit does not have a developer.
rules.detail: The audit does not have a developer.

rules.title: No sources selected
rules.summary: The audit does not have any selected sources.
rules.detail: The audit does not have any selected sources.

rules.title: No logic steps
rules.summary: The audit does not contain any logic steps.
rules.detail: The audit does not contain any logic steps.

rules.title: Workbook import warning
rules.summary: The imported workbook reported a warning.
rules.detail: The imported workbook reported a warning.

rules.title: Source or field reference is invalid
rules.summary: The audit contains a source or field reference that is no longer valid.
rules.detail: Review selected sources and the affected logic reference.
rules.documentation: Uses current selected-source and loaded catalog identities; does not infer field relationships.

rules.title: Source replacement is unmatched
rules.summary: A source replacement left a field or replacement source unmatched.
rules.detail: Open the mapping tool and match the remaining field, or remove the unused replacement source.
rules.documentation: Reads unmatchedSourceReplacements stored by the Sources replacement tool.

rules.title: Logic hierarchy issue
rules.summary: A logic step has an invalid hierarchy relationship.
rules.detail: A logic step has an invalid hierarchy relationship.

rules.title: Condition is incomplete
rules.summary: An audit condition is incomplete or invalid.
rules.detail: An audit condition is incomplete or invalid.

rules.title: Action is missing
rules.summary: A step that requires an action has no direct or meaningful descendant action.
rules.detail: A step that requires an action has no direct or meaningful descendant action.

rules.title: Join is incomplete
rules.summary: A join is incomplete or invalid.
rules.detail: A join is incomplete or invalid.

rules.title: Created-field reference is invalid
rules.summary: A created-field reference is removed or occurs before creation.
rules.detail: A created-field reference is removed or occurs before creation.

rules.title: Created column name issue
rules.summary: A created column has no name or duplicates another created column.
rules.detail: A created column has no name or duplicates another created column.

rules.title: Calculation is incomplete
rules.summary: A calculation contains an invalid or incomplete operation.
rules.detail: A calculation contains an invalid or incomplete operation.

rules.title: String transformation is incomplete
rules.summary: A string transformation is invalid or incomplete.
rules.detail: A string transformation is invalid or incomplete.

rules.title: Display Field selection is invalid
rules.summary: A Display Field selection is invalid or duplicated.
rules.detail: A Display Field selection is invalid or duplicated.

rules.title: No Display Fields selected
rules.summary: The audit does not have any selected Display Fields.
rules.detail: The audit does not have any selected Display Fields.

rules.title: Compared fields have no JOIN relationship
rules.summary: This field comparison uses sources that are not connected by a direct or indirect JOIN.
rules.detail: Add or correct a JOIN path between the compared sources, or change the fields used by this condition.
rules.documentation: Uses enabled, complete INNER, LEFT, RIGHT, and FULL OUTER JOIN steps as undirected source relationships. UNION does not establish connectivity.
